relationships.subject: Procyanidin C1
relationships.evidence_quote: PCC1 activated the sirtuin 3 (SIRT3)/forkhead box O3 (FOXO3) signaling pathway

relationships.subject: acidic pH stress
relationships.evidence_quote: acidic pH stimulation upregulated the expression of DRP-1 and FIS1 and downregulated that of MFN-2, OPA-1, SIRT3, and FOXO3

relationships.subject: Procyanidin C1
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with PCC1 could attenuate this increase in a dose-dependent manner

key_findings: PCC1 protects human nucleus pulposus cells from acidic pH-induced apoptosis, mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics imbalance.
PCC1 acts via SIRT3/FOXO3 and ameliorates IVDD in a rat model.
